Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application because your CV does not meet the following required criteria: 4 years of data science experience, hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (Pyro, PyMC3, JAGS or similar), experience with Amazon SageMaker, experience with PySpark, strong working knowledge of SQL, and understanding of Bayesian methods, time series analysis, or sensor signal processing.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
